title: Janfotooɓe Suɓaaɓe
intro: E nder daartol, nulaaɓe diine ina njaha e nder neɗɗaagal, won heen ɓurɓe ɓadaade ɗum en ina mbaawi anndude annoore. Ndee ɗoo tinndinoore ina taaroo yontaaji ɗiɗi ɗi ɓadtaade annabaagal wonti jarribo mum en, e ndonu mum en ko jannde nde alaa ɗo haaɗi.
clues: En nguurii e jamaanu annabaaɓe mawɓe, tee gite men ina keddii ina njuuti e goonga mo ɓe ngaddi oo.
Galleeji amen ina keewi wahyu Alla, kono ɓerɗe amen ina tiiɗi.
Min resndanoo ko worɓe cuɓaaɓe ngam jeertinde leñol mum en.
Nde jukkungo ari, en ɗaɓɓaani hoɗorde e nder laana, en ndogaani toɓo ngulngo, sabu en njaltii jeertinaali ɗii.
En cifaama e nder Quraan ko yeru wonande keefeere, hollirde wonde hay jokkondiral ɓadtingal e annabi hisnataa.
Minen ko min rewɓe Nuuhu e Luut, janfotooɓe ɓe, ko noon ɓe ñaawirtee.

trial.label: Hol ko wonnoo ñaawoore maɓɓe ?
options: Ɓe resndi ko annabaaɓe kono ɓe ngooŋɗinaani
Ɓe ngoni ko e ɓiɗɓe, ɓe aybi annabaaɓe
Ɓe ngonnoo ko alɗuɓe e mawnikiniiɓe
Ɓe jarribaama Ibliis ngam yaltude galleeji maɓɓe
trial.answer: Ɓe resndi ko annabaaɓe kono ɓe ngooŋɗinaani

outcome.label: Hol ko wonnoo joofnirde maɓɓe?
options: Ɓe mbayliima wonti ɓowɗi e baali

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
